newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord shareholders ok Westinghouse deal.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord shareholders ok Westinghouse deal.

text.p: Gaylord Entertainment Co said Friday that its stockholders have approved Westinghouse Electric Corp's acquisition of its TNN: The Nashville Network, and the U.S. and Canadian operations of CMT: Country Music Television, for $1.55 billion in Westinghouse common stock.
The company said about 87.5 percent of its shares were voted in favor of the transaction at a special meeting of stockholders held earlier Friday.

As previously announced, Gaylord Entertainment's remaining operations, consisting of its hospitality, attractions, music, television and radio businesses, as well as the operations of CMT outside the U.S. and Canada, and its interest in the Z Music cable network, will be spun off to stockholders immediately prior to the merger with Westinghouse.
Subject to certain conditions, the company expects the transaction to close before the end of September.
